2608.27101.title: pro-team at LLMs4OL 2026 Tasks Flagship and Reuse: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Vocabulary-Constrained Filtering for Ontology Learning
2608.27101.paper_summary: Ontology learning from text remains challenging despite significant progress in Large Language Models (LLMs), which can hallucinate domain terms, produce inconsistent formats, and favor hierarchical over associative relations. In the LLMs4OL 2026 Challenge, we address both the End-to-End Flagship Task (Task A) and Ontology Extension Reuse Task (Task B) using an offline retrieval-augmented few-shot prompting pipeline. Our system employs Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for demonstration retrieval, selecting the top-5 examples for Task A and top-2 for Task B. A left-truncated context-windowing strategy preserves task instructions within long prompts. For Task B, generated triples undergo deterministic vocabulary-constrained filtering, retaining triples when at least one endpoint belongs to the sample's closed term/type vocabulary and removing duplicates of the initial ontology. The approach achieves Semantic Graph Similarity of 0.8692, Term-Typing F1 of 0.9200, and Taxonomy Discovery F1 of 0.8540 on Task B, while Task A achieves 0.7416 Semantic Graph Similarity. However, no non-taxonomic relations are extracted, highlighting limitations of closed, taxonomy-oriented relation vocabularies.
2608.27101.paper_summary_zh: 本體學從文本中學習仍然具有挑戰性，儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）已取得顯著進展，但它們可能會產生領域術語的幻覺、產生不一致的格式，並偏好層級關係而非聯想關係。在LLMs4OL 2026挑戰中，我們使用離線檢索增強的少量提示管道，解決了端到端旗艦任務（任務A）和本體擴展重用任務（任務B）。我們的系統使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct和all-MiniLM-L6-v2進行演示檢索，為任務A選擇前5個示例，為任務B選擇前2個示例。左側截斷的上下文窗口策略在長提示中保留任務指令。對於任務B，生成的三元組經過確定性詞彙約束過濾，當至少一個端點屬於樣本的封閉術語/類型詞彙時保留三元組，並刪除初始本體的重複項。該方法在任務B上實現了0.8692的語義圖相似度、0.9200的術語標記F1和0.8540的分類發現F1，而任務A達到了0.7416的語義圖相似度。然而，未提取任何非分類關係，突顯了封閉的、以分類為導向的關係詞彙的局限性。
